evidence.title: Iconify Design: All popular icon sets, one framework.

name: Iconify
summary: One framework for 300,000+ open source icons from 200+ icon sets, with components, an API and design-tool plugins.
description: Iconify unifies 300k+ icons from 200+ open source icon sets (Material Design, Phosphor, Remix, Carbon, Bootstrap, Tabler, Feather, Fluent, IconPark, Octicons and more) behind one toolchain: an icon web component, framework-native components for React, Vue, Svelte and Ember, SVG-with-CSS usage, an on-demand API you can self-host, and plugins that browse and import icons into design tools.
contains: 200+ icon sets, cleaned up, optimised and kept up to date
icon web component plus native components for React, Vue, Svelte and Ember
public API for icon data, on-demand SVG and CSS, and search; can be self-hosted
plugins and icon pickers for UI design tools
project code mostly MIT (some older packages Apache-2.0/GPL-2.0); icon sets use their own licenses
